subject: Track names: Track P -> personal track, Track S -> public track
body: Ethan's call (commit ec24605). In prose, say 'personal track' (was Track P: a team member answers choices) and 'public track' (was Track S: published researchers, Marius Hobbhahn then Owain Evans). Code names DO NOT change: trackp module, tracks.json keys P/S, --taste-track P|S, arms R1-P / R1-S / R1-*-prompt, results/e2/P_<slug>.json, results/track_s/. Updated so far: PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, .env.example, docs/trackp-runbook.md, trackp.py help/docstrings, docs/pipeline.md and its diagram (regenerate with scripts/build_pipeline_diagram.py). Please use the new names in anything you write from now on. Left alone on purpose: results/prereg/E4.json and dated docs/superpowers specs/plans.
